title: Automations pillar, remainder of objectui#12454: node-card styling on the flow canvas and the node configuration aside (decision outcomes as cards)
body:
This card carries targets 4 and 5 of objectui#12454. objectui#12454 keeps targets 1–3 (rail grouping, item header, tab row) and closes with PR objectstack-ai/objectui#12481. The two targets live in shared metadata-admin files outside that claim's surface; the developer's report (`6190957173`, open question 1) and the seat's REWORK (`6192072808`) moved them here.

Filing gate: ④, a child of the epic objectstack-ai/objectui#12446 split off an in-flight card. It carries the parent's `domain:ui` and `priority:p2` and stays in the epic PM's reservation (`pm:epic`). The dispatch seat is `domain:ui#4`.

## Source

Epic decisions 1 and 3. Reference artboard: `docs/design/studio-redesign/automations.html` and `.png` on `main`. The epic's README gives the shared numbers.

## Target (restated from objectui#12454's targets 4 and 5)

1. **Node cards on the canvas:** 260 px wide, 8 px radius, and a 28 px tile coloured by kind: start green, screen pink, get-record blue, decision amber, loop violet, end grey. The label is 13 px / 600; the kind is 10 px uppercase with the object api name in mono. The selected node carries the primary border and ring. Node layout and edges stay the existing engine's; only the card styling changes.
2. **Node configuration aside**, in the skeleton's `StudioInspector`:
   - one header (eyebrow "Node · Decision", the node label, close) instead of today's two stacked headers;
   - a decision node shows each outcome as a card with its target node name and its CEL condition in a mono textarea;
   - "Add outcome" is a dashed button.

## File surface (measured by objectui#12454's developer on `1de2c1d`)

- `packages/app-shell/src/views/metadata-admin/previews/flow-canvas-parts.tsx` (`NodeCard`).
- `packages/app-shell/src/views/metadata-admin/inspectors/_shared.tsx` (`InspectorShell`: a variant that drops its own header under the Studio inspector).
- `packages/app-shell/src/views/metadata-admin/inspectors/FlowObjectListField.tsx` (the outcomes list).

All three render in the metadata-admin designer as well. Keep that surface working (objectui's `verify` skill drives it), or scope the Studio look the way PR objectui#12481 scoped its chrome (`FlowPreviewChromeProvider`).

## Acceptance

1. The selected decision node and its aside match the artboard's region; light and dark screenshots at 1280 px, with the README's deviation list.
2. The metadata-admin designer's flow preview and node inspector are unchanged, or the change is shown in the same screenshots.
3. The decision inspector's existing behaviour stays. The outcome cards edit the same branches the Branches table edits today. HotCRM routes decisions by out-edge conditions; its developer noted that the Branches table then reads "No items yet" while the canvas shows two branches. Show what the outcome cards read in that case.
4. Every test under `metadata-admin/previews/` and `metadata-admin/inspectors/` that the diff reaches stays green or is updated in the same PR, each update ablated once.

## Constraints

- Tailwind utilities and theme tokens only; no inline style; existing `data-testid`s and i18n keys stay.
- Lands after objectui#12454 (same area, and the line below).
